rows.en: "Celestial Being" is the name of the organization we belonged to back in our original world.
By "we," I mean Seravee Gundam, Arios Gundam...
00 Gundam, and yours truly, Cherudim Gundam.
Well, we only go by that name for convenience's sake.
At first, the four of us fought on our own. Then one day, Wing Zero and the others showed up.
Along with a violent tremor.
From what they told us, they'd been pulled in here too, just like us.
Wing Gundam Zero, Gundam Deathscythe Hell, Gundam Sandrock, Gundam Heavyarms...
And Altron Gundam. Every last one of them has real backbone.
We welcomed them in right away and decided to fight together. That's how it went.
Well, that's about the long and short of it.
(A tremor...? That tremor just now... Could someone else have been dragged into this world...?)
The enemy's base is set up so nobody can get into it directly.
You've gotta go by way of the "Ride Dungeon."
Ah... the "Ride Dungeon" is what we call the "space outside" the Cubes.
But that Ride Dungeon turned out to be a real nasty piece of work.
It's full of high-density Minus Energy. Going out there in the flesh is way too dangerous.
So we boarded the transport ship "Ptolemaios I" and set out to attack their base.
But get this... there was a terrifyingly powerful enemy lurking in the Ride Dungeon.
Our unarmed transport ship didn't stand a chance against it.
The Gaia Cubes are worlds made by pulling in each of our worlds and rebuilding them.
There are several Cubes, and they float in what you'd call "another dimension."
But we haven't been able to figure out how many there are.
And there's one thing all the heroes who got pulled in have in common...
It's that they've lost the power they're supposed to have had in their original worlds.
But that power didn't just vanish. It seems to be sleeping somewhere in this world.
The enemy calls their whole lot "Regis."
Regis is a group uniting all the forces that opposed the heroes in their original worlds.
Why they've done that, I've got no idea.
But new-model mobile suits attack alongside kaijin and kaiju... It's a real pain in the neck.
It looks like the enemy's goal in this Cube is to develop new fighting forces.
And the key to that is digging up the "power" sleeping in the Cubes.
Getting tech from worlds they never should've had, plus the power we used to have...
The enemy's base is built so that nobody can get into it directly.
You've gotta go by way of the "Ride Dungeon."
Ah... the "Ride Dungeon" is what we call the space outside the Cubes.
But that Ride Dungeon turned out to be a real nasty piece of work.
It's full of high-density Minus Energy. Going out there in the flesh is way too dangerous.
So we boarded the spaceship "Ptolemaios II" and set out to attack their base.
But get this... there were enemies lurking in the Ride Dungeon too.
Our unarmed spaceship didn't stand a chance against them.
We're terribly sorry. Please wait at the camp until you receive orders.
We've already heard about you from Master Deathscythe Hell.
So this is where you were. I've been looking for you.
The op plan'll take a while yet to draw up, but before that, could you do me a favor?
Before that, could you do me a little favor?
I need you to secure the route to the Ride Gate.
You'll get the details on-site. My buddies are waiting in an area called the "Quicksand Zone."
My buddies are waiting up ahead in Area 2.
That's Gundam Heavyarms, Arios Gundam, and Wing Gundam Zero.
You probably haven't met Heavyarms and Arios yet, but I've filled them in, so no need to worry.
This is a vital mission the whole operation depends on. Give it everything you've got!!
I'm counting on you!!
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Did you meet up with Heavyarms and the others yet? They're in the Quicksand Zone, y'know?
Did you meet up with Sandrock and the others yet? They're in Area 2, y'know?
Glad you made it. Deathscythe Hell told us about you.
I'm Gundam Heavyarms. Good to meet you. And this here is...
Arios Gundam. Nice to meet ya.
What we want you to do is take out the Antlar up ahead.
A kaiju called Antlar has built its nest there, and now we can't get to the "Ride Gate."
The Ride Gate is a kind of hole leading outside the Cube, into the "Ride Dungeon."
To attack the boss's base, we first have to go out into the Ride Dungeon.
To move the operation forward, we have to get rid of Antlar first.
But it's not an opponent we can beat easily...
From its antlion-pit nest comes a Capture Ray with a powerful magnetic pull that draws in everything.
It fires a powerful magnetic ray from an antlion-like pit.
Antlar lurks in its nest and drags anything that comes near it down under the ground.
Unless we stop the Capture Ray and lure it out, we can't even fight it.
But how're we supposed to do that?
But how do we do that?
But how would we...
But how're we gonna pull that off?
But how?
But how the hell are we supposed to do somethin' like that?
But how do we do that?
Now, hold on. There's one way...
Deep in this area, the Quicksand Zone, lie the ruins of the legendary city of Baraj.
The "Blue Stone of Baraj" lies sleeping there.
If we throw it into Antlar's nest, the Capture Ray should disappear.

notes.note: Ankh's inner thought, kept in parentheses as in the source; 'tremor' links back to Cherudim's 'violent tremor' (#0.27) and the shaking felt earlier.
Source writes 'Ptolemaios I' here (transport ship) but 'Ptolemaios II' (spaceship) in the legacy variant 0211.6; both numerals kept as written.

Rows 0208-0211 are legacy (older-script) variants of Cherudim's 0207 explanations. Mis-decoded kanji inferred from the 0207 versions: 0209.7 'excavation', 0209.8 'originally', 0211.1 'structure', 0211.2 'by way of', 0211.3 'outside', 0211.5 'high density' / 'dangerous', 0214.1 'met'.
Legacy variant differs from 0207.41: just 'there were enemies in the Ride Dungeon too' (no 'terrifyingly powerful'); translated as written, plural 'them' in 0211.8.
Subject 'why' restored as 'Why they've done that' (i.e. why the villains of all worlds joined forces).
Maganac's honorific 'sama' on Deathscythe Hell rendered 'Master Deathscythe Hell' (servant register, as for Master Quatre); no prior precedent in the corpus.
Area name 'Ryuusa Chitai' rendered 'Quicksand Zone' (not in glossary). Rows #0.3, #0.6 and 0214.1 are alternate/earlier variants (Area 2, Sandrock) translated as written.
Source has a typo for 'yoroshiku tanomu ze'; Deathscythe Hell asking the party -> 'I'm counting on you!!'.
Speaker '???' is almost certainly Heavyarms (introduces himself next row); 'us' used as both Gundams were briefed.
Antlar's 'kyapuchaa kousen' rendered 'Capture Ray' (capitalised as an attack name; not in glossary). #0.11 is a shorter alternate variant.
Rows #0.14-0.20 are leader variants of 'But how do we do it?'; only #0.14 labelled (Zero). Voiced by register: #0.16 polite trailing-off, #0.19 rough (Momotaros/Ankh-style).
'Hitotsu houhou ga aru' -> 'There's one way...'; Arios speaks casually in this scene (source 'yoroshiku na'), voiced accordingly.

report: 80/80 rows. Legacy variants 0208-0211, 0214 had mis-decoded kanji inferred from the matching 0207 lines. Uncertain: 0215.1 '???' taken as Heavyarms; 0207.40/0211.6 Ptolemaios I vs II kept as written; leader variants 0215.14-20 voiced by register. Not in glossary: Quicksand Zone (area), Capture Ray (Antlar), Baraj (city; glossary has Blue Stone of Baraj), Ptolemaios I/II, 'Master' for Maganac honorific.
